h: פָּרָשַׁת אַחֲרֵי מוֹת, ו׳ Acharei Mos, 6
Spiritual Coldness Can Awaken Greater Zeal for Hashem

p: "She does not fear snow for her household,
כִּי כָל בֵּיתָהּ לָבוּשׁ שָׁנִים (מִשְׁלֵי לא, כא)
for all her household is clothed in scarlet" (Mishlei 31:21).
That is, there is a level in the husk
and it is "the first of nations, Amalek,"
"who cooled you off and made you lukewarm."
what are his Torah and his service worth?
whom it cannot entice to evil;
לְבִלְתִּי עָצְבִּי (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים א ד, י)
"'That it not grieve me' (Divrei HaYamim I 4:10):
that the yetzer hara not overwhelm me
who was the root of Torah she'b'al peh,
and restored through his reasoning the halachos
in the days of mourning for Moshe,
that the yetzer hara not cast
and through this be kept from learning.
there are two kinds of Gehinnom:
all of which are called fire
corresponding to the husk of Amalek.
"And where do they complete their sentence?
the snow is their shadow of death."
That is, only the nations of the world,
until they complete their sentence in snow.
this husk rules over the great,
And against this one needs pride,
כְּמוֹ שֶׁנֶּאֱמַר (דִּבְרֵי הַיָּמִים ב יז, ו)
"And his heart was lifted up in the ways of Hashem";
וְאִיתָא בַּזּוֹהַר הַקָּדוֹשׁ (בֹּא, חֵלֶק ב לב, ב)
and it says in the holy Zohar (Bo, II 32b):
And in the reverse it is written (Devarim 32:18),
"You weakened the Rock who bore you":
that they weaken the power above
(as stated in the Sifrei on Ha'azinu);
and this is a kind of pride and loftiness.
"She does not fear snow for her household":
she does not fear for the members of her household
from the accusation of the yetzer hara,
"for all her household is clothed in scarlet."
וְהוּא עַל דֶּרֶךְ מַה שֶּׁאָמְרוּ (שַׁבָּת פט, ב)
And this is along the lines of what they said (Shabbos 89b):
אִם יִהְיוּ חֲטָאֵיכֶם כַּשָּׁנִים (יְשַׁעְיָה א, יח)
like these years that are arranged and come
from the six days of Creation,
they shall become white as snow";
for such was the will of Hashem Yisbarach
so that the light would be praiseworthy;
וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב (זוֹהַר חֵלֶק ב קפד, א)
except that which comes out of darkness,
except that which comes out of evil."
And so through the coldness and the sadness
that the inclination brought into him.
And this is what it says,
"for all her household is clothed in scarlet":
that their deeds be like these years
from the six days of Creation;
